title: Replay of #15: a session whose state lost its jobs gets them back from the store (issue #11)
notes: Source 1bc830e (the parent of PR #15), hidden tests from its merge faa02a8 (tests/ replaced whole). testsChanged is true: PR #15 changed tests/workers.test.tsx. The issue is the real one; both comments were posted before the PR. Not in the issue, but the reference test checks it: the test seeds $.store under the key jobs:<session id> (the value is {at, jobs}, and each job has name, profile, cwd, dir, startedAt, status and token). The issue does not give that layout, so a fix that keeps the jobs under another key fails the test. Left out of the issue on purpose, per the plan's rule for replays.
